title: From Scale to Resilience: Rethinking Efficient AI System
body: From Scale to Resilience: Rethinking Efficient AI System
AI Impact Summit Pre Event
Venue: Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore
Date: 20th January 2026
Time: 10:00 AM to 16:15 PM IST (GMT +05:30)
Context:

The India–AI Impact Summit 2026 will be the first global AI summit hosted in the Global South. Informed by deliberations at leading international forums, the Summit is structured around Working Groups addressing seven interconnected themes, guided by the principles of People, Planet, and Progress. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to transform everyday lives and drive inclusive growth by expanding access to education, healthcare, clean energy, and livelihoods. Yet today’s AI paradigm is constrained by heavy reliance on compute, data, and energy, creating rising costs and barriers to adoption.

In response, the Resilience, Innovation, and Efficiency Working Group will facilitate dialogue and collaboration—anchored in Global South perspectives with global relevance—to advance AI systems that are high-performing yet resource-efficient, accessible and scalable under constraints, and responsive to diverse societal needs, ensuring that no one is left behind.
About the Event

Advancing the vision of Resilient AI, the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) will host a pre- Summit event on 20 January, followed by a hybrid, closed-door Working Group meeting at IISc Bengaluru. The pre-Summit event will serve as a global platform—anchored in Global South perspectives—for bringing together Working Group members and distinguished leaders from technology, entrepreneurship, research, and academia. The programme will showcase resilient AI technologies and foster deliberations on future research directions and policy pathways, contributing to globally relevant frameworks for efficient, scalable, and impactful AI systems that address real-world constraints and advance inclusive development.

title: AI by HER — Pre-event, India AI Impact Summit
body: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) will host the India–AI Impact Summit 2026 on February 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. The Summit to be inaugurated by the Shri Narendra Modi Hon’ble Prime Minister will be a global convening to shape the future of inclusive, responsible, and resilient Artificial Intelligence.

Building on the momentum of multilateral efforts at Bletchley Park, Seoul, Paris, and Kigali, the Impact Summit will mark a shift from aspirations to measurable Impact, demonstrating how AI can advance tangible outcomes for People, Planet, and Progress.

As part of its flagship initiatives, a challenge will be held for women engaged in AI, titled “AI by HER” to help showcase, accelerate and promote women-led innovation in AI, identifying and supporting transformative solutions across startups, academia, and research that deliver social and economic value at scale.
WEP (Women Entrepreneurship Platform), an initiative of NITI Aayog that is presently working as a PPP has been entrusted for conducting this Challenge.

In this context, IISc Bengaluru, ARTPARK, and the India AI Mission, with support from Govt of Karnataka, and in partnership with WEP, are hosting a Pre-Summit Event on 17 November 2025 at IISc, Bengaluru.

This gathering will serve as a decentralized platform for dialogue, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing, enabling diverse stakeholders to contribute meaningfully to the Summit’s priorities. The event aims to foster inclusive and actionable insights on advancing AI for equitable impact

title: CodeBot Hackathon 2025
body: Congratulations Finalist!
We extend our heartfelt congratulations to the selected participants: Here is the list of finalists
Code to Solve, Innovate to Evolve!

CodeBot Hackathon is a competition organised by ARTPARK @ IISc, open to innovators, developers, and tech enthusiasts. Whether you're an experienced coder or a beginner eager to learn, this is your chance to showcase your skills, collaborate with like-minded individuals, and create impactful projects.
We invite teams to choose problem statements in Agriculture, Healthcare or Smart City/Village, and build impactful, innovative solutions using:
Robotics & AI
IoT & 5G/Advanced communications
AR/VR
Immersive Skilling, Summative ∑ Approach
Unlike typical hackathons, this initiative has been envisioned in 2 parts:

1. 3-month fully virtual training program* to equip teams with mentorship and other resources. In the weeks leading up to the event, teams will participate in a structured and rigorous training program* with many opportunities to connect with peers and learn from seasoned mentors. We will offer virtual 1:1 mentoring sessions, workshops and spirited discussions to facilitate brainstorming and development of novel ideas.

2. Finale on 17th July, 2025 in-person at ARTgarage. CodeBot culminates in a one-of-a-kind experience with a hackathon hosted at ARTgarage in Bengaluru – a world-class facility for robotics and autonomous systems, home to startups creating the future of deep-tech.
*While the hackathon will be held in person in Bengaluru, all training sessions will be held virtually to accommodate teams from all over the country.

The Eligible Participants for this Hackathon 2025 are Academia, Start-ups, and Working Professionals.

Organised by: ARTPARK @ IISc, supported by TIH, IIT bombay
ARTPARK @ IISc (AI & Robotics Technology Park) fosters innovations in AI & Robotics by bringing together the best of research, startup, industry, and government ecosystems.
ARTPARK drives mission-oriented deep-tech projects, technology business incubation, and translational research in areas such as industrial automation, mobility, agriculture, healthcare and education.
It is a nonprofit organization seed-funded by the Department of Science & Technology (Government of India) and the Government of Karnataka.

ARTgarage Incubatory is a state-of-the-art manufacturing and testing facility for robotics and autonomous systems. It enables innovation and incubation through advanced manufacturing and the latest communication and autonomy-AI technology infrastructure. The goal is to develop unique and differentiated assisted and fully autonomous intelligent systems for industrial, social and defence purposes.

TIH IIT Bombay has been set up at the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Powai, Mumbai 400076 (Host Institute), as a Section-8 company (not-for-profit) under the National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS), being implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India.

TIH focuses on creating a self-sustaining innovation continuum by fostering inter-disciplinary, collaborative and translational research for technology and product development, building highly knowledgeable human resources and a vibrant start-up ecosystem, in the technology area of Internet of Things (IoT), Generative AI, and Quantum Sensing.

title: ROSCon India 2024

ROSCon India is returning to Bangalore - the Silicon Valley of India. Bangalore's thriving ecosystem of startups, research institutions, and tech giants provides the perfect backdrop for fostering collaboration and advancing the ROS community in India and beyond.

title: ROSCon India 2023
body: ROSCon India, a pioneering initiative co-hosted by Acceleration Robotics, RigBetel Labs and powered by ARTPARK at IISc. ROSCon India is an exceptional platform aimed at fostering collaboration, learning, and innovation within the field of robotics, particularly focusing on the Robot Operating System (ROS). ROSCon India stands as a remarkable opportunity for researchers, developers, and robotics enthusiasts to converge, interact, and exchange their insights, ideas, and experiences related to ROS. title: Global Partnership on AI Summit
body: India was elected as the Incoming Chair of the Global Partnership on AI (GPAI) in November 2022. It brings together experts from science, industry, civil society, governments, International organisations and academia to foster international cooperation on responsible AI.

title: NaCDEC VI — Design Challenge
body: ‘NACDeC VI - The National Design Challenge: Air Ambulance’ was a year-long competition organized by ARTPARK @ IISc, AeSI Design Division and AeSI Mumbai Branch and The Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE), India. Over 45 brilliant ideas and designs took flight in the competition, all aiming to create an autonomous and advanced Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) vehicle for advanced air mobility.

title: Robotics Challenge — Grand Finale
body: In ARTPARK’s first-ever Robotics Challenge, we invited students from India’s coveted engineering colleges to develop a robotic janitor capable of cleaning and maintaining a washroom. We believe that while we’ve come a long way in our journey to achieve universal sanitation coverage, this could be crucial to make clean toilets a reality. Apart from one year of continuous mentorship, the teams were given a grant worth ₹4 L to build their robots. With this initiative, we’re hoping that the Robotic Janitors pave the way for the new reality in India.

title: ARTPARK Innovation Summit
body: ARTPARK-IISc organised the ARTPARK Innovation Summit in March, 2022. This one-day hybrid event brings Industry, Academia and the Government under one roof to discuss important issues about the growth of the AI and Robotics ecosystem in India. The theme for last year was “Connecting the Unconnected”- and the conversations were about creating next- generation connectivity in rural areas, Health AI for Bharat, Connecting Bharat with Drones, Inclusive learning for the future and building AI and research ecosystem.

title: Seminar on Advanced Air Mobility
body: Through this seminar, ARTPARK aimed to understand the current challenges and the opportunities to improve the healthcare scenario that exists today in the country. Significant recent investments in Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) systems are maturing a new class of electric aircraft and automation technologies that may provide benefits to Air EMS operations. Furthermore, opportunities to deploy Air EMS assets as part of a UAM system to increase utilization and reduce costs through a system of network planning and revenue management can provide a cost advantage over the existing system. Finally, we also aim to unlock the potential of open innovation by bringing about the strengths of the startup community, Aerospace and Healthcare Industry and the Government to work towards breaking technological and regulatory barriers and create products and services that have the potential to create a massive impact to serve our society and generate a large amount of jobs.
